refnamediv.refpurpose: Set the output format of string values of the session

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public boolSNMP::setStringOutputFormat Snmp\StringOutputformat
Sets the format in which the string values returned by the requests of this session are printed. The format only applies to string values whose MIB object has no DISPLAY-HINT.
It does not change the format used by the other sessions, nor by functions such as snmp2_get; use snmp_set_string_output_format for those.
